summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K containing a Monthly Return of Equity Issuer on Movements in Securities for August 2026, submitted to the Hong Kong Exchange. The filing reports no changes in authorized or issued share capital for Class A or Class B ordinary shares during the month. It includes a public float sufficiency confirmation, stating compliance with the 15% minimum public float requirement. This is a routine administrative disclosure required of foreign private issuers with Hong Kong listings, not a special-situation event.
